calibration_sources: NVIDIA Dynamo Distributed Inference Framework & NIXL (NVIDIA Inference Xfer Library) Architecture Whitepapers
NVIDIA Triton Inference Server vs. Dynamo Evolution Guide & Ray Serve LLM / KServe Production Benchmarks
Disaggregated Prefill-Decode SLA Goodput & Dynamic Planner Rebalancing Studies

workload.cluster_and_model: 64xH200 GPUs (8 Nodes × 8 GPUs) serving 70B–671B LLM/MoE under bursty mixed traffic (4K–64K prompts, SLA: TTFT <= 1,000 ms, TPOT <= 18.0 ms)
workload.triton_vs_dynamo_evolution: Classic Triton was built for stateless single-node tensor in/out (ResNet/BERT/ONNX); Generative LLMs are stateful (hundreds of GBs of distributed KV cache across nodes) requiring Dynamo + NIXL
workload.nixl_abstraction: NIXL (NVIDIA Inference Xfer Library) unifies NVLink P2P, GPUDirect RDMA (UCX/IBGDA), Host DRAM, and GDS NVMe behind a non-blocking zero-copy transfer API

tiers.name: Tier 1: 传统 Triton Inference Server 单机模式 (擅长 CV/BERT/小模型，缺乏跨机 KV 路由与 PD 分离)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Classic Triton Inference Server (Stateless Single-Node Focus, No Native Cross-Node PD/KV Routing)
tiers.recommended_for: Traditional CV / ASR / BERT / ONNX / TensorRT multi-model ensembles fitting inside a single GPU or single node.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 标准 KServe 声明式平台 (K8s CRD 多模型生命周期管理，但默认无状态网关无感知 KV)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Standard KServe Declarative Platform (K8s CRD Lifecycle, Stateless Ingress Without NIXL PD Split)
tiers.recommended_for: Enterprise MLOps teams managing hundreds of standardized K8s InferenceServices with Canary rollouts and scale-to-zero.

tiers.name: Tier 3: Ray Serve LLM 复合智能体编排 (Python 原生多模型 DAG 流水线 + 前缀感知 Actor 路由)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Ray Serve LLM Compound-AI Orchestrator (Python Multi-Model DAGs + Prefix-Aware Actor Routing)
tiers.recommended_for: Compound AI applications combining OCR + Embedding + Reranker + LLM + Guardrails in dynamic Python DAGs with fractional GPU sharing.

tiers.name: Tier 4: NVIDIA Dynamo + NIXL 分布式推理系统 (Rust 控制面 + 全局 KV 智能路由 + NIXL 零拷贝 PD 分离 🏆)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: NVIDIA Dynamo + NIXL Distributed Serving (Rust Control Plane + KV Smart Router + NIXL Zero-Copy PD Split)
tiers.recommended_for: Large-scale 64–4,096 GPU LLM/MoE AI factories requiring disaggregated Prefill-Decode, NIXL RDMA KV transfer, and 3.21x SLA Goodput.
